project.name: HuLLCirq 4×4 INT8 NPU
project.implementation_scope: Six node contracts and sixteen-PE serial NPU integration target; actual execution status is recorded separately in histories.

wiring_requirements: Preserve every saved graph edge and exact public port name. Instantiate all five non-PE node modules once and the adopted PE module sixteen times.
Gate external loads to the register buffer while not busy; load source-job addressed bytes before accepting configuration.
Connect control schedule_config and post_config handshakes to scheduler and post respectively. Post configuration is saved config[133:5].
Broadcast rst OR scheduler pe_clear to all sixteen PE resets before first product. Do not use pair_meta.first as a same-cycle input reset.
Select one PE by pair_meta[3:0]. Admit one operand pair only when no previous PE result is pending and that PE is ready. Capture lane and last metadata on the pair transfer.
While result is pending, drain non-final partial sums from only the selected PE; route final sums to post with its backpressure. Clear pending only on the selected PE output transfer.
Route post result_data into FIFO. FIFO output_data is the external final stream. FIFO output_transfer pulse drives control output_transfer exactly.

Control job_done occurs after sixteen actual final external transfers, never merely schedule_done. Reject overlapping configurations. Shared synchronous reset cancels pending state/response/outputs while preserving loaded operand bytes.

nodes.name: Job control
nodes.behavior: One original matrix job at a time. Config134: K[4:0]1..16,ReLU[5],signed32 column biases[6+32*i+:32]. States IDLE,SEND_CONFIG,RUN,DONE. IDLE config_data_ready=!rst && incoming K in1..16, independent of valid. Config handshake latches all134 bits, clears independent schedule_sent/post_sent flags and output count, then SEND_CONFIG. SEND_CONFIG schedule_config_valid=!schedule_sent and post_config_valid=!post_sent, gated !rst. schedule_config=saved_config134; post_config={saved_config[133:6],saved_config[5]}129. Hold each valid/data until its own ready handshake; then drop only that valid. Enter RUN after both handshakes, including simultaneous handshakes. Do not count output_transfer on the SEND_CONFIG-to-RUN edge. RUN counts actual final FIFO output transfer pulses;16th enters DONE. DONE job_done1cycle then IDLE. busy=!rst && state!=IDLE, including DONE; job_done=!rst && state==DONE. Reject config while busy. Ignore output_transfer outside RUN. Sync high rst overrides, clears saved config/state/flags/count, and gates ready/valid/busy/job_done low. Raw output_transfer must be actual final FIFO output valid&&ready in global integration; scheduler dispatch done is not job completion. No arbitrary timeout or fake completion pulse.
nodes.test_expectations: Same unchanged original GUI matrix job for RTL and netlist. Fixed independent exercise uses invalidK0/17 by changing only K bits, independent staggered configuration stalls in both completion orders, busy config offers held until reset, non-RUN output pulses ignored, reset after5final transfers, restart and16final transfers, one done pulse. Finite control-boundary evidence only; S08 must prove actual FIFO/output integration and numerical results.

sideband.meaning: Actual final FIFO output_valid && output_ready; count only in RUN.
High in SEND_CONFIG, RUN and DONE; low in IDLE and during reset.
One cycle after the 16th final output transfer; not scheduler dispatch completion.

nodes.name: A / B input buffers
nodes.behavior: Register banks A[64],B[64] unsigned8 storedbytes. load_data16: byte[7:0],addr[13:8],bank[14](A0/B1),reserved15=0. read_request16: Aaddr[5:0],Baddr[13:8],reserved[7:6]/[15:14]=0. read_response16 low8=A/high8=B. One response slot. load_data_ready=!rst&&!response_valid&&load_data[15]==0. read_request_ready=!rst&&!response_valid&&!load_data_valid&&reserved_read_bits==0. Load has priority. Accepted load writes exactly one bank/address. Accepted read registers packed operands and asserts response_valid next cycle. Hold response/data under stall; accepted response clears valid. No same-cycle response consume/read replacement. Synchronous high rst cancels pending response and gates all ready/valid low; it MUST NOT reset either stored bank. No initial memory values are assumed; only loaded addresses may be read. Physical memory retention is not claimed.

nodes.name: Array scheduler
nodes.behavior: Serial row-major16-lane dispatch, no instantiated array yet. Config: K[4:0]=1..16, ReLU[5], signed32 biases[6+32*i+:32]; ignore ReLU/bias in scheduler. IDLE config_ready=!rst && K in1..16, independent of valid. Config handshake latches K, zeroes lane/index/data, enters CLEAR. CLEAR pulses pe_clear1cycle then ISSUE. ISSUE holds request_valid/address until handshake then WAIT. Request[5:0]=row*16+k_index; [13:8]=k_index*4+column; reserved[7:6]/[15:14]=0. WAIT response_ready=1; handshake stores16bits then EMIT. Pair low8=A/high8=B signed8. EMIT holds pair_valid/data/meta until pair_ready handshake. Meta[3:0]=lane=row*4+column,[4]=index0,[5]=indexK-1; only valid with pair_valid. Pair handshake advances index; after K pairs lane++/index0; lane15 last pair->DONE; otherwise ISSUE. DONE pulses schedule_done one cycle: dispatch completion, not final output completion. Sync high rst overrides, clears state/counters/data, gates all ready/valid/pulses low. Config_ready only IDLE,response_ready only WAIT,request_valid only ISSUE,pair_valid only EMIT; one outstanding read. Pair_data holds between responses. Future integration: broadcast pe_clear reset before first product; first is metadata. Drain intermediate PE sums; retain final metadata. Buffer shares reset/cancels old responses.
nodes.test_expectations: Same original job/frozen independent recipe for RTL/netlist. Held-pair abort forces pair_ready0 after5pairs until EMIT held, then reset. Final K4 dispatch64pairs/16lanes; stalls/delays, invalidK0/17, busy config, two reset aborts. Public checks only; no full-NPU/exhaustive claim.

nodes.name: INT8 PE template
nodes.behavior: Single PE implementation intended for reuse across the 4x4 output-stationary array. Synchronous active-high rst clears signed INT32 accumulator, acc_data and acc_data_valid to zero. pair_data low8 is signed INT8 a and high8 is signed INT8 b. pair_data_ready = !acc_data_valid || acc_data_ready, including during reset. On each non-reset rising clk input handshake, compute signed8* signed8 (16-bit signed product), add it with sign extension to the accumulator modulo 2^32, and publish the new accumulator on acc_data with valid=1. Output-only handshake clears valid while retaining accumulator/data. Simultaneous input/output handshakes replace the consumed output with the new sum. During output backpressure, hold acc_data and valid and do not consume input. Reset has highest priority. No initial values or extra ports. Global integration must drive this rst at each job boundary; that integration remains planned.
nodes.test_expectations: Executable PE verification uses the 42 GUI-saved cycles in verification.vectors, projected from row0 of the saved K=4 matrix job across all four columns. Each column begins with reset. Check mixed signs and INT8 extrema, acceptance into an empty output while downstream is stalled, output/data hold, rejected inputs during stalls, simultaneous consume/replace, output-only clearing, accumulator retention, and reset priority. This finite projection does not verify the complete NPU, K=1/16, long-run INT32 wraparound, bias/ReLU or FIFO. Verification input is frozen at this GUI save and reused without per-stage substitution.

nodes.name: Bias and ReLU
nodes.behavior: Registered signed32 bias/ReLU output, row-major column counter0..3. post_config129 packs ReLU[0],four signed32biases[1+32*c+:32]. post_config_ready=!rst&&!out_valid&&column==0. Accepted config latches allbits,sets configured1,column0. acc_data_ready=!rst&&configured&&(!out_valid||result_data_ready)&&!post_config_valid. Accepted acc_data adds selected bias[column] modulo2^32,then zeroes result if configReLU and signed wrappedsum<0. Register result_data/valid; advance column modulo4 per accepted acc_data. Simultaneous oldoutput consume/newinput accept replaces slot; output consume without replacement clears valid. Hold result_data/valid under stall. No input before configuration; reconfigure only between rows after slotempty. Synchronous high rst clears configured,column,outputvalid and gates all ready/valid low. Metadata routing/final PE sum selection is global work.

nodes.name: Output FIFO
nodes.behavior: Depth2 signed32 FIFO, preserve accepted result_data order. output_data_valid=!rst&&(count>0); result_data_ready=!rst&&((count<2)||(output_data_ready&&output_data_valid)). output_data is current head only meaningful while valid; hold head under stall. Support full simultaneous pop+push, empty push (no combinational bypass), circular pointer wrap; count changes bypush-minuspop. Synchronous high rst empties queue/resets pointers/count and gates ready/valid low. No need clear memorybits. FIFO doesn't identify job boundaries/count16; globalcontrol counts accepted finaloutputs. Raw output_transfer=output_data_valid&&output_data_ready is the exact accepted-output pulse,including consecutivecycles; sendtojobcontrol.
